sheets.name: How to use
rows: Open Content Bugs first. This is the working backlog for all content issues found against the business model.
When you fix a bug in the website, set Status to Done in Content Bugs and add a new row in Fix Log with date, files, and what changed.
If work is partially started, set Status to In Progress so the Summary sheet counts stay accurate.
Use Business Alignment to check whether a rewrite still matches Wirero positioning before publishing.
Do not reintroduce em dashes. Prefer commas or short sentences (BUG-001 standard).
Never imply major media placements, guaranteed traffic, journalist pickup, or unlimited publishing without plan context.
Ask Droid to update this Excel every time a content bug is fixed so status stays current.
